Context.title: Pipeline latency and provider instability in Russia-region deployments
Context.problem-summary: Current STT and translation providers do not reliably achieve sub-second latency. Deepgram and Groq are unstable from Russia. Yandex STT/Translate and local LiteLLM are more reachable but too slow on the current critical path.
Context.user-goal: Reach a stable low-latency bidirectional pipeline, prioritizing local-first execution for ru<->en while preserving the current dual-pipeline UX.

affected-modules.module: Deepgram primary STT, Yandex fallback, local Whisper fallback
Groq, LiteLLM, Yandex translation chain, plus existing CTranslate2 wrapper in model.rs
Critical path orchestration, timeouts, queueing, transcript-to-translation handoff
Runtime config injection and telemetry routing
Future preset exposure and latency observability

failure-packets.packet-ref: Translation timeout and serial fallback amplification on slow networks

Analysis.finding: Deepgram final transcript latency is inflated by finalization settings such as endpointing and utterance_end_ms, which delays downstream translation even when speech is already complete.
Yandex STT and local Whisper fallback are batch-oriented in the current implementation, so they cannot reliably meet a sub-second target without architectural changes.
Translation fallback is serial on the hot path. A slow or blocked provider increases tail latency before the next provider is even tried.
Local translation capability is already partially present in `native/audio_engine/src/translation/model.rs`, but it is not integrated into `TranslationEngine` as a first-class provider.
The current processor model waits for final STT output before translation and TTS, so the pipeline does not yet benefit from partial or stable-partial overlap.

Wave.name: FastLatencyRelief
Wave.goal: Reduce avoidable latency in the existing cloud-centric path without changing the user-visible architecture.

change.summary: Lower Deepgram finalization delays for realtime mode.

acceptance.item: `pipeline_trace.log` shows updated realtime endpointing settings.
Short phrase `stt_final_ms` improves versus baseline by at least 300 ms.
No loss of final transcript production in both directions during smoke test.

change.summary: Replace serial translation fallback with fastest-success policy for realtime mode.

acceptance.item: Slow or blocked Groq no longer delays fallback until full timeout.
Logs expose the winning provider for each translation.
`p95 translate_ms` drops by at least 30 percent on degraded-network tests.

change.summary: Remove per-request HTTP client construction from translation hot paths.

acceptance.item: No per-request `Client::builder()` remains on the realtime translation path.
Repeated short translations show reduced cold-start variance.

change.summary: Add stage-level latency markers needed to compare pre/post optimization.

acceptance.item: Each completed utterance records `stt_ms`, `translate_ms`, `tts_ms`, `total_ms`, and `provider_used`.
The logs support p50 and p95 calculations by stage.

Wave.name: LocalFirstCriticalPath
Wave.goal: Move STT and translation off unstable external services for the ru<->en critical path while preserving the current dual-pipeline flow.

change.summary: Replace per-request Whisper subprocess execution with a persistent local STT worker.

files.file: scripts/ or worker runtime file to be introduced during implementation

acceptance.item: No temp WAV file roundtrip remains in the local STT hot path.
No per-utterance `pythonw.exe` process launch remains for local STT.
Local STT can operate as a primary provider without contacting Deepgram.

change.summary: Integrate the existing CTranslate2 translation wrapper as a first-class local provider.

acceptance.item: `ru<->en` translation works in a local-only mode with no Groq, LiteLLM, or Yandex dependency on the hot path.
Translation provider logs clearly distinguish `local_mt` from cloud providers.
Short-phrase `translate_ms` is lower and more stable than the cloud fallback baseline.

change.summary: Separate fast audio path from optional quality or correction path.

acceptance.item: Audio output is produced from the fast local path without waiting for cloud correction.
UI state can show a live translation and a revised translation independently.

change.summary: Add configuration support for a Russia-oriented local-first preset.

acceptance.item: A single preset enables local STT, local MT, and aggressive realtime thresholds.
Restarting the engine from saved settings preserves the preset selection.

verification.evidence: Both pipelines run in local-only mode.
Local STT and local MT generate transcript and translation events without external API availability.

Wave.name: IncrementalStreamingArchitecture
Wave.goal: Reach a stable sub-second experience by overlapping STT, translation, and playback on stable partials instead of full-utterance boundaries.

change.summary: Emit partial and stable-partial transcript events from the STT layer.

acceptance.item: Stable partials reach the UI before final transcript completion.
Final transcripts remain backward-compatible with the current event flow.

change.summary: Add text segment stabilization and stale-job cancellation.

acceptance.item: Repeated partial prefixes are not retranslated unnecessarily.
Stale translation and TTS jobs are canceled or dropped with explicit log markers.

change.summary: Allow early playback from confirmed translated segments instead of waiting for full utterance completion.

acceptance.item: `time_to_first_audio_ms` is logged and measured separately from total utterance time.
Users hear the beginning of the translation before the source speaker finishes long sentences.

verification.evidence: Stable partial transcript markers appear before final transcript markers.
Playback starts before full-utterance translation completion on long test sentences.

OpenDecisions.decision: Whether local STT should be implemented with faster-whisper, whisper.cpp, or another persistent runtime.
Whether the existing CTranslate2 wrapper should be the default local MT backend or remain one of several options.
Whether partial-translation audio should be enabled immediately or gated behind a feature flag until correction behavior is validated.

acceptance-targets.target: Improve cloud-path tail latency without reducing pipeline stability.
Achieve full local-only ru<->en pipeline functionality.
Approach a consistent sub-second user-perceived response on short phrases and early-audio response on longer phrases.

Notes.note: This document is planning-only. It does not change module contracts or claim implemented behavior.
When implementation begins, update `docs/development-plan.xml`, `docs/verification-plan.xml`, and `docs/knowledge-graph.xml` only for the waves that are actually executed.
